'''Tamatsukuri Shrine''' (たまつくりじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in Kurose-chō, {{ill|Numazu|ar|نامازو (شيزوكا)|arz|نامازو|azb|نومازو، شیزوئوکا|bg|Нумадзу|ce|Нумадзу|ceb|Numazu (lungsod sa Hapon)|de|Numazu|eo|Numazu|es|Numazu (Shizuoka)|et|Numazu|fa|نومازو، شیزوئوکا|fi|Numazu|fr|Numazu|ga|Numazu|gl|Numazu|hr|Numazu|id|Numazu, Shizuoka|io|Numazu, Shizuoka|it|Numazu|ja|沼津市|ko|누마즈시|mg|Numazu|mn|Нүмазү|mzn|نومازو، شیزوئوکا|nl|Numazu|no|Numazu|pl|Numazu|pt|Numazu|ro|Numazu|ru|Нумадзу|sh|Numazu|simple|Numazu|sr|Нумазу|sv|Numazu|szl|Numazu|tg|Нумазу|th|นูมาซุ|tl|Numazu|tr|Numazu|tt|Нумадзу|uk|Нумадзу (Сідзуока)|ur|نومازو، شیزوکا|vi|Numazu, Shizuoka|war|Numazu, Shizuoka|zh|沼津市|zh_classical|沼津市|zh_min_nan|Numazu-chhī|zh_yue|沼津|qid=Q241037}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}.<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4403146 Tamatsukuri Shrine] - Shizuoka Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines</ref>

=== Overview ===
The shrine is situated on the eastern side of the south bank of Kurose Bridge, which spans the {{ill|Kano River|arz|نهر كانو|ceb|Kano-gawa|de|Kano (Fluss)|fa|رود کانو|fr|Kano-gawa|ha|Kogin Kano|ig|Osimiri Kano|ja|狩野川|ru|Кано (река)|th|แม่น้ำคาโนะ|zh|狩野川|qid=Q6364188}}.

Although the date of its founding is unknown, it is identified with the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} '''Tamatsukuri Mizujinja''' (たまつくりみずじんじゃ) and is an ancient shrine recorded in the {{ill|Izu Province Shrine Rank Register|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}} as “Junior Fourth Rank Upper, Tamatsukuri Myōjin.”<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/tamatukuri_title.htm Tamatsukuri Shrine] - Genbushi</ref><ref name="oz">[https://humizuki.com/omaturi_zanmai/sight/jinja/numazu/tamatukuri.htm Tamatsukuri Shrine] - Omatsuri Zanmai</ref>

In {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 8 ({{ill|1875|Q7764|qid=Q7764}}), it was designated as a village shrine.<ref name="oz"/>
